neet_che_u01_t04_1.working: 1 mol H2SO4 contains 2 mol H, 1 mol S, 4 mol O and N_A molecules. So option 1 is correct.

neet_che_u01_t04_2.working: Moles = 4.9/98 = 0.05 mol. Each molecule has 7 atoms, so 0.35 mol atoms. 0.35 x 6.022e23 = 2.108e23.

neet_che_u01_t04_3.working: 16 g O2 = 0.5 mol. Molar volume at 273.15 K and 1 bar is 22.7 L/mol, so 0.5 x 22.7 = 11.35 L.

neet_che_u01_t04_4.working: 1 mol O3 has N_A molecules, each with 3 O atoms, giving 3N_A O atoms. Both are true and R explains A.

neet_che_u01_t04_5.working: I: 1.8 g H2O = 0.1 mol; 10 electrons per molecule gives 1 mol electrons = 6.022e23, so correct. II: 0.1 mol N2 and 0.1 mol O2 each give 0.2 mol atoms, so correct.
